title: POST samplesheet schema
description: Samplesheet for POST benchmarking runs. The msa_dir column MUST be the full-family MSA directory, for example proteinfamilies full_msa/filtered/... or mgnifams families/full_msa/. Do not point msa_dir at a seed MSA directory.

sample.description: Required unique run identifier and primary key.

tool.description: Required tool or parameter label used for grouping.

msa_dir.description: Required path to the full-family MSA directory. This is the sole membership source.
